excerpts.locator: physical322/printed306, V3iv1–3; next physical323 checked for boundary
excerpts.finding: All three paragraphs visually read. Six first-created holy angels of God, entrusting all creation/growth/build/rule and completion, subordinate carriers, common joy/glorifying God, and completion reason remain. Third question uses exodos and dynamis. The refusal of superior worthiness, others prior/better, visions appropriate to them, God-name glory, to-you past/future revelation, double-minded heart question, truth and all three final assurances remain. The entire section ends on322;323 beginsV3v. No raw or normalized source-body change.

All three paragraphs of the diplomatic transcription visually read. Both six numerals, first-created holy angels of God, entrusted creation/growth/build/rule, completion and common joy remain. In3 Athos has diaphora rather than selected exodos; it has an additional eti before future revelation and estai in the question where working text has estin. It retains to-you past/future revelation, double-minded heart question and all final truth/strong/sure/founded assurances. Same codex as other Athos editions, not an additional witness vote; no original-photo collation claimed.

All ab/app/rdg layers re-read, with no gap or supplied elements in these extracted units.12.1 first exēkonta is corrected by ca to hex; first-created, God angels, Lord entrusting all creation/growth/build/rule remain.12.2 first six before superior is removed by S1; rejoicing first singular corrected S1 plural, God angels/completion/reason remain.12.3 S1 corrects asked/her forms, S1/ca add missing sou after others; first has future revelation only, ca adds past verb and and but no explicit soi. First lacks the full whether-these-things-are-or-not clause; S1/ca add it. Truth/strong/sure/founded remain, with strength spelling corrected S1/ca. Correctors distinguished from independent codices; no fresh manuscript photograph collation.

All V3iv visually read. Six young builders, holy angels of God first constituted (primo constituti), all creation entrusted, create/build/rule, and completion. Other carriers are holy angels of Lord; superiority without repeated six; completion, common joy and Lord-glorification remain. Exitus/power question; others prior/better and visions, God-name glory and to-you past/future revelation; doubters with are-or-not heart question; truth and three assurances remain. Apparatus explicitly reports omission of six in the superiority clause. Printed edition and apparatus are mediated witnesses, not each a separate codex.

All V3iv visually read. Six builders, holy angels first created, Lord entrusts all creation for increase/build/rule, tower completion. Other carriers angels of God, six predecessors, common joy, glorifying God/completion remain. Exitus/virtus question, not most worthy, others prior/better, visions, God-name glory, to-you past/future revelation, doubters disputing in hearts whether true-or-not and final truth/strong/firm/founded remain. Edited grammar and apparatus distinguished from codex text; not a new independent vote.

All V3iv visually read in Latin rendering of Ethiopic. Young builders lack the first six numeral; holy angels of Lord first created, entrusted everything created and tower completion remain, without the growth/build/rule expansion. Other carriers Lord angels subordinate to former builders, common joy and Lord-glorification/completion remain. Question asks character/explanation of stones. Not superior to all, many others better/prior, explanatory wording and God-name glory, present explaining and future showing, doubters/heart positive-or-negative question, all true/no lie/firm/sure/founded remain. Note on119 proposes a pronoun correction; note on120 proposes an infinitive correction and reports an older translator. These proposals are not preserved manuscript readings, direct Geʿez collation or a separate Latin manuscript family.

excerpts.locator: P.Oxy.4706 fragment1, printed4; eleven lines of V3iv3/global12.3
excerpts.finding: Edition identified fragment1 and its restoration boundaries. Surviving material is a narrow right-hand strip of eleven lines, not a continuous copy of12.3. At line4 a second sou is restored for space though absent Athos/E; line7 soi and most of the past revelation verb are restored, and line8 and/still/most future verb are restored. Line9 reasoning-word opening is preserved but omission of repeated tous is inferred from spacing. Line11 estin is restored before a surviving final n; Athos estai differs, but the complete selected verb is not preserved in this fragment. No claim that all bracketed words are visible. Bodmer B agreements in the apparatus are edition reports, not freshly acquired Bodmer collation.

excerpts.locator: image37554847 upper-left long strip, matched to Gonis fragment1
excerpts.finding: Photo inspected against the published eleven-line layout and lower margin. Successive visible right-edge groups match ei ina, loi gar, eltei, kaly, auta, o ono, alyphth with damaged ending, setai, dialo, kardi and n tau. These groups locate the passage and preserve only word-parts in several places. Lost left portions, including the double-minded noun, to-you pronoun, conjunction and still, are not certified as photographed letters. Fine dotted-letter certainty remains edition-mediated; this bounded match does not claim a full independent transcription.
